reports.desc: The scam is from an attorney claiming they have a client (in the name of a relative of yours) that says they have an estate that has not  been paid out yet due to their COVID-19 death in 2021. The scam hopes that 10% of the estate will go to a charitable organization while splitting the remaining 90% between the heir and the attorney.
Order was delayed several times and not authentic merchandise as described in advertising.

July 13, 2026, I needed a garage door replacement immediately. I was given a name by a friend. I cannot remember exactly how this person came about contacting me . This individual came to my home the evening of 7/13/26. I assumed he was legitimate. First mistake!!!!  I showed him my garage door and be proceeded to take measurements from inside and out of the garage. We gave me a total cost of $1800.00. He said he would take half to get the materials ordered. I gave him my credit information of 7/13 and never heard from him since that time. I asked to give me his phone number so I could get an idea of when the job would take place. He said he would give me that information LATER. That is when a bell went off in my head. I KNEW THEN I HAD BEEN SCAMED FOR $945!!!!

Recieved 2nd text from this number: "Susan, I still haven't heard back regarding your loan request. I need to know if you'd like to continue. Call me or reply with the best time.- Amy" I never requested or applied for a loan anywhere.

Google said number for a towing service this number came up. They at first set up the towing and stated it would be $399.00. I paid over the phone with my debit card. about an houir went by and they called me back saying they needed to send another driver from a "sister" company and it would require a second payment of $156.00.  The service was provided, however, my bank flagged the charge of the second payment. (I had to use a back up credit card for the $156). Along with flagging that charge they tried to charge another $197.47 from my debit card.  Then the credit card I had to use was locked after my bank notified me and they tried charging another, $23.99, $30.24, $24.48, $26.48, $197.47 and another $197.47,
After all this took place on a friday 9/18/2026 the second charges were tried this morning9/21/2026 throughout the early morning. Then I recieved a text stating I needed to resolve all those further charges asap.  I blocked and deleted the number which was 1(901)402-0495

Scammer sent me a letter stating that my home warranty was about to expire and I had one last chance to renew it. They listed the bank I had my mortgage with and my home address. I have never had home warranty coverage

Offered a home job assembling product but ended up doing tasks till my shipment arrived. At first it seemed legit. But then tgey would add on another task to do and if you didnt complete it you lost your money. Never was told ahead of time about a second task. Just out of the blue popped that on you to press you for more money involved. Never got my money back. Never got my bonuses ether.
PayPal is covering for this furdulent company.

I bought a safety tool to break car windows or cut a seatbelt in an emergency. I ordered them for myself and my family for peace of mind. The photos show the advertisement and the actual product, which claims to have a tungsten tip to break glass, it does not! Also is a list of materials used, tungsten is not on it! Thank you.

They claim to provide real pearls, but after having a jeweller check it, it turned out to be some kind of plastic. I would never pay that kind of money for plastic. The product description is misleading and fake.

I ordered 2 Full size blankets. It was taking a long time with nothing heard from the company   I finally got 2 blankets that were so small, I thought they might be Crib Blankets.  I had two back and forth emails with some named marie who told me to lay the blankets on a bed, measure them and send her a picture. I said no. It was too OBVIOUS that these blankets were too SMALL for a Double/Full size bed. I sent her a copy of her own Fleece Company Ad with measurements of their supposed blankets, AND a statement of “Easy Returns and/or Exchanges” on the ad.  I was asking for an address and instructions on how to return. She would NOT supply that info. As a matter of fact, after sending her a copy of her ad, she stopped communicating with me.
